_note: §9.2.3 (v0.9.15) — what each Gen I move's card illustration shows: the effect itself, never a creature. Fed to scripts/gen-move-art.mjs, which wraps it in one style paragraph and adds the type's palette; scripts/install-move-art.mjs turns the image into true pixel art. A '+' variant wears its base move's art.
